about.title: WHO WE ARE
paragraphs: CASANOVA is the official digital identity of the B.Com 2026–2029 batch.
We are dreamers, creators, athletes, designers, leaders and future professionals — brought together by one classroom and shaped into one story.
This website preserves our memories, our achievements, and the journey we're building together, one year at a time.

timeline.title: College Begins
timeline.text: New faces, new classrooms — the first chapter of CASANOVA is written.

timeline.title: Freshers
timeline.text: The night the batch stopped being strangers and became a family.

timeline.title: Commerce Fest
timeline.text: Stalls, stages and spreadsheets — commerce came alive for three days.

timeline.title: Sports Meet
timeline.text: Jerseys on, egos aside — CASANOVA competed as one team.

timeline.title: Industrial Visit
timeline.text: Textbooks met the real world, and the real world took notes back.

timeline.title: Farewell
timeline.text: Three years, one legacy — the final bow of the CASANOVA batch.

footer.quote: Every legend begins as a batch.
